analysis_notes.summary: Colts traded Quenton Nelson to Seattle for 3rd and 5th round picks and DeForest Buckner to San Francisco for a 4th round pick.
analysis_notes.speaker: Producer Jack
analysis_notes.quote: The team's traded Pro Bowl guard Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks for 3rd and 5th round picks, and they also sent defensive tackle DeForest Buckner to the 49ers.

analysis_notes.summary: Bengals TE Erick All Jr. (torn ACL) and Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. were placed on Injured Reserve.
analysis_notes.speaker: Producer Jack
analysis_notes.quote: Bengals tight end Erick All Jr. and Giants running back Tyrone Tracy, they're both placed on IR with injuries as well.

analysis_notes.topic: Draft Stock Impact of Returning to School
analysis_notes.summary: Dante Moore's decision to return to school led to injuries and poor performance, costing him significant NFL draft value.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: He very possibly cost himself millions upon millions of dollars by taking in my mind a very unnecessary risk.
